newsitem.title: USA: Trico Marine completes 2.76 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Trico Marine completes 2.76 mln shr offer.

text.p: Trico Marine Services Inc said on Thursday that it completed a public offering of 2.76 million shares of common stock at a price of $39 each.
Of the total, 850,000 shares were offered by the company and 1.91 million by certain stockholders.
The offering was lead-managed by Schroder Wertheim & Co Inc, with Raymond James & Associates Inc and Simmons & Co International as co-managers.
The company will use the proceeds to repay debt incurred in recent acquisitions of supply vessels located in the Gulf of Mexico.
Trico has about 7.5 million shares outstanding, a company spokesman said.
